_comment: INSPECTRA Rule Library — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
_note: These rules implement a subset of LM(PC) Rules 2011 for the MVP demonstration. Rules are applied deterministically by the rule engines. AI agents provide evidence; rule engines make the structural determination.

declaration_rules.name: Product Identity Declaration
declaration_rules.description: Every package shall carry the generic or specific name of the commodity.

declaration_rules.name: Net Quantity Declaration
declaration_rules.description: Every package shall declare the net quantity in standard units of weights and measures.

declaration_rules.name: Manufacturer / Packer Name
declaration_rules.description: Name and complete address of the manufacturer or packer shall be declared on the package.

declaration_rules.name: Manufacturer / Packer Address
declaration_rules.description: Complete address of the manufacturer or packer shall be declared.

declaration_rules.name: Month and Year of Manufacture
declaration_rules.description: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or packed shall be declared.

declaration_rules.name: MRP Declaration
declaration_rules.description: Every package shall carry the maximum retail price inclusive of all taxes.

declaration_rules.name: Consumer Care Information
declaration_rules.description: Consumer care address and/or telephone number shall be declared.

declaration_rules.name: Country of Origin
declaration_rules.description: For imported commodities, country of origin shall be declared.

measurement_rules.name: Net Quantity Detected
measurement_rules.description: A net quantity declaration must be detectable on the package.

measurement_rules.name: Standard Unit Used
measurement_rules.description: Net quantity shall be expressed in standard units: g, kg, ml, L.

measurement_rules.name: Plausible Quantity Value
measurement_rules.description: The declared quantity numeric value shall be plausible (> 0 and <= 50000 in normalized units).

measurement_rules.name: Label Readability
measurement_rules.description: Declarations shall be legible and clearly printed. Requires human verification if average OCR confidence is below 80%.
